editorial.blurb: Corridor Brewery & Provisions is a bright, lively gem in the Southport Corridor where excellent house beers and thoughtfully crafted sandwiches make for a perfect casual escape.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the beer flight to sample all their offerings, and don't skip the umami fries — reviewers rave about the $2 upcharge being absolutely worth it.

topDishes.note: 10/10 perfection with elevated umami flavor, cooked perfectly
Flavorful with freshly roasted, hand-carved turkey—no pre-packaged deli meat
